'''Jeremy Lossee''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2001 Utah State Championship]] in April 2001, according to Casey Barson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2064">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-smeg-runnin-states-like-butter-ut-04-01d2064/ smeg-runnin-states-like-butter-ut-04-01], DeckTech (Casey "Smeg" Barson, 13 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-13-smeg-runnin-states-like-butter-ut-04-01d2064/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
